purpose: Customer product release gate. Execute with a real browser runner against a credentialed deployment.

steps: Open every public route directly
Reload each route
Confirm HTTP 200 and visible content
Confirm no uncaught console error
Open /demo directly
Confirm redirect to /login?returnTo=%2Fonboarding
Confirm no synthetic demo content appears
Complete sign-in with the dedicated evaluation account
Confirm /onboarding opens
Open every protected route without a session
Confirm redirect to /login
Confirm a same-origin returnTo is preserved
Confirm // or backslash returnTo values are rejected
Submit invalid credentials
Confirm actionable error with no secret echo
Request password recovery and confirm the response does not disclose whether the account exists
Exercise a pre-issued break-glass code and confirm it cannot be reused
Complete password recovery and confirm refresh sessions are revoked
Exercise OAuth callback timeout/retry
Confirm callback returnTo is consumed once
Create a device code
Open the verification link
Authorize the code
Confirm polling reaches authorized or expired
Confirm enrollment token is masked and can be cleared
Open billing with a demo account
Verify direct-GA checkout is absent, invoice/sales links are safe HTTPS or mailto, and the order-reconciliation notice is visible
Verify absent status/terms configuration shows a visible fail-closed notice
Run axe-core on each route
Require zero critical/serious violations
Check keyboard-only navigation and visible focus
Check dialog/alert names and live-region announcements
Run only synthetic hook probes from docs/demo/customer-threat-demo-matrix.md
Confirm deny/ask verdicts are ingested for the enrolled demo agent
Open /incidents and confirm the runtime_verdict rows are visible with agent/runtime context
Confirm allow and PII-gap probes are not presented as blocked incidents

failOn: failed network request (except documented auth retries)
